title: 12 Best Rooftop Cafes in Jaipur
description: The best rooftop cafes in Jaipur — curated from Reddit. Hawa Mahal views, Nahargarh Fort panoramas, Moroccan-themed terraces & chai culture spots. Interactive map included.

places.name: Tapri Central
places.address: Prithviraj Rd, C Scheme, Ashok Nagar

redditQuotes.text: A rooftop cafe called Tapri is one of my favorites, though now a bit crowded.
redditQuotes.source: — r/jaipur · Firangi visiting Jaipur for first time

redditQuotes.text: Tapri Central: That classic rooftop vibe with a view that never gets old. Perfect for chai and good conversation. A-Tier.
redditQuotes.source: — r/jaipur · The Best Cafe Detailed Guide

places.verdict: The most recommended rooftop cafe in Jaipur across Reddit, travel blogs, and local forums — and it earned every mention. Tapri is a tea house first, cafe second, and the city views are the cherry on top.

comparison.best for: Chai lovers, sunset views, budget-friendly terrace vibes
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 13,845 reviews · Vintage-eclectic decor · Panoramic city views · Vegetarian menu
comparison.limitations: Gets very crowded at sunset · No alcohol · Purely vegetarian
comparison.what to order: Their signature masala chai is the reason most people come. The Maggi is overpriced (₹200) but part of the experience. Bun maska and kachori are the sleeper hits.

places.whatToOrder: Their signature masala chai is the reason most people come. The Maggi is overpriced (₹200) but part of the experience. Bun maska and kachori are the sleeper hits.
places.editorialSummary: The most recommended rooftop cafe in Jaipur across Reddit, travel blogs, and local forums — and it earned every mention. Tapri is a tea house first, cafe second, and the city views are the cherry on top.
places.bestFor: Chai lovers, sunset views, budget-friendly terrace vibes

places.name: The Tattoo Cafe & Lounge
places.address: 3rd floor, 30, Opposite Hawa Mahal, Hawa Mahal Rd

redditQuotes.text: Found a rooftop cafe in Jaipur with direct Hawa Mahal views — Tattoo Cafe. The palace lights up at night and it's magical.
redditQuotes.source: — Instagram viral post · Jaipur rooftop cafe recommendations

redditQuotes.text: Coffee tastes better when Hawa Mahal is right in front of you. ₹500 per person, AC seating available. Best at sunset.

places.verdict: The single best rooftop for a direct, unobstructed Hawa Mahal view. Women-owned, and the night-time views when the palace lights up are genuinely spectacular.

comparison.best for: Hawa Mahal photos, sunset drinks, tourist-friendly experience
comparison.strengths: Direct Hawa Mahal view · AC indoor seating · Live music · Women-owned
comparison.limitations: Touristy · Wait times at sunset · Food is average
comparison.price / value: ₹500–₹1,000 for two · Fair for the view
comparison.what to order: Come for the view, not the food. Order coffee or a cold drink and focus on the rooftop terrace. The pizza and pasta are serviceable but forgettable.

places.whatToOrder: Come for the view, not the food. Order coffee or a cold drink and focus on the rooftop terrace. The pizza and pasta are serviceable but forgettable.
places.editorialSummary: The single best rooftop for a direct, unobstructed Hawa Mahal view. Women-owned, and the night-time views when the palace lights up are genuinely spectacular.
places.bestFor: Hawa Mahal photos, sunset drinks, tourist-friendly experience

places.name: Wind View Cafe
places.address: 3rd Floor, Badi Chopad, Hawa Mahal Rd, opposite Hawa Mahal

redditQuotes.text: Wind View Cafe — Hidden gem with panoramic Nahargarh Fort views, budget-friendly ₹600.
redditQuotes.source: — Instagram · Top 5 Rooftop Cafes with Fort Views in Jaipur

places.verdict: The budget option for Hawa Mahal views. The food gets mixed reviews, but the terrace overlooking the Palace of Winds is genuinely one of the best photo spots in Jaipur — and you can grab a coffee for under ₹200.

comparison.best for: Budget Hawa Mahal views, laptop-friendly, solo travelers
comparison.strengths: Direct Hawa Mahal panorama · Budget-friendly · Rooftop seating · Quiet atmosphere
comparison.price / value: ₹200–₹600 for two · Best budget-to-view ratio in Jaipur
comparison.what to order: Stick to chai, coffee, and simple snacks. The view is what you're paying for — don't expect culinary magic.

places.whatToOrder: Stick to chai, coffee, and simple snacks. The view is what you're paying for — don't expect culinary magic.
places.editorialSummary: The budget option for Hawa Mahal views. The food gets mixed reviews, but the terrace overlooking the Palace of Winds is genuinely one of the best photo spots in Jaipur — and you can grab a coffee for under ₹200.
places.bestFor: Budget Hawa Mahal views, laptop-friendly, solo travelers

places.name: Bar Palladio Jaipur
places.address: Kanota Bagh, Narayan Singh Rd, Rambagh

redditQuotes.text: Bar Palladio — the iconic blue court. While not a conventional rooftop, it offers an unparalleled open-air, aesthetic experience.
redditQuotes.source: — jaipurvibes.in · 10 Best Rooftop Cafes in Jaipur

places.verdict: Not a rooftop per se, but an open-air garden bar so stunning it would be criminal to leave it off. Designed by Dutch designer Marie-Anne Oudejans, the blue-and-white Mughal-Colonial interiors are unlike anything else in Jaipur.

comparison.best for: Date nights, cocktails, architecture lovers, special occasions
comparison.strengths: Iconic design · Full bar with cocktails · Italian-Indian fusion menu · Garden setting
comparison.limitations: Reservations required · Premium pricing · No city skyline views
comparison.price / value: ₹2,500–₹4,000 for two · Worth it for the experience
comparison.what to order: The Negroni is excellent. The Italian menu is solid — wood-fired pizzas and pasta complement the drinks well. Try the Palladio Spritz.

places.whatToOrder: The Negroni is excellent. The Italian menu is solid — wood-fired pizzas and pasta complement the drinks well. Try the Palladio Spritz.
places.editorialSummary: Not a rooftop per se, but an open-air garden bar so stunning it would be criminal to leave it off. Designed by Dutch designer Marie-Anne Oudejans, the blue-and-white Mughal-Colonial interiors are unlike anything else in Jaipur.
places.bestFor: Date nights, cocktails, architecture lovers, special occasions

places.name: Padao Restaurant (Nahargarh Fort)

redditQuotes.text: Eat at rooftop cafe outside Amer fort, really good. Padao Cafe at Nahargarh is the highest point in Jaipur!
redditQuotes.source: — r/jaipur · Visiting Jaipur for 2 days, need suggestions

places.verdict: The highest rooftop in Jaipur — because it's literally inside a fort on a hill. The food is canteen-style (run by Rajasthan Tourism), but the 360° panorama of the entire Pink City at sunset is worth every rupee of the winding drive up.

comparison.strengths: Highest vantage point · 360° city panorama · Government-run (affordable) · Alcohol available
comparison.limitations: Canteen-quality food · Remote location (drive/taxi required) · Closes early
comparison.price / value: ₹600–₹1,200 for two · Incredible value for the views
comparison.what to order: Beer and snacks — keep expectations low for the food but enjoy the sunset. The dal makhani is the best option on the limited menu.

places.whatToOrder: Beer and snacks — keep expectations low for the food but enjoy the sunset. The dal makhani is the best option on the limited menu.
places.editorialSummary: The highest rooftop in Jaipur — because it's literally inside a fort on a hill. The food is canteen-style (run by Rajasthan Tourism), but the 360° panorama of the entire Pink City at sunset is worth every rupee of the winding drive up.

places.name: Skyfall Restaurant
places.address: 5th Floor, Ridhi Tower, SB 57, Tonk Rd
places.verdict: Jaipur's most popular all-purpose rooftop — great food, full bar, city views, live music, and it stays open until 1 AM on weekends. The 5th-floor perch opposite SMS Stadium gives panoramic views.

comparison.best for: Group dinners, nightlife, celebrations, all-day dining
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 6,491 reviews · Full bar · Multi-cuisine · Open late · Valet parking
comparison.limitations: Can get loud · Weekend reservations recommended
comparison.price / value: ₹1,200–₹2,000 for two · Good value for the experience
comparison.what to order: The tandoori platters are excellent. Cocktails are well-made — try the Skyfall Signature. The Italian and Lebanese menu sections are surprisingly good.

places.whatToOrder: The tandoori platters are excellent. Cocktails are well-made — try the Skyfall Signature. The Italian and Lebanese menu sections are surprisingly good.
places.editorialSummary: Jaipur's most popular all-purpose rooftop — great food, full bar, city views, live music, and it stays open until 1 AM on weekends. The 5th-floor perch opposite SMS Stadium gives panoramic views.
places.bestFor: Group dinners, nightlife, celebrations, all-day dining

places.name: Jaipur Adda
places.address: Rooftop, Nirwana Hometel MI Road, Bani Park
places.verdict: The "Modern-Desi" rooftop that captures the spirit of young Jaipur. Live DJ sets, vibrant decor, excellent Indian fusion food, and a rooftop that's equal parts lively and photogenic.

comparison.best for: Groups, nightlife, Indian fusion food, DJ nights
comparison.strengths: Vibrant decor · Live music/DJ · Full bar · Kids menu available
comparison.limitations: Opens at 3 PM only · Can be noisy
comparison.price / value: ₹1,000–₹1,400 for two · Good value with alcohol
comparison.what to order: The signature cocktails and mocktails are the highlights. The Indian fusion snacks are genuinely well-done — try the desi tapas platter.

places.whatToOrder: The signature cocktails and mocktails are the highlights. The Indian fusion snacks are genuinely well-done — try the desi tapas platter.
places.editorialSummary: The "Modern-Desi" rooftop that captures the spirit of young Jaipur. Live DJ sets, vibrant decor, excellent Indian fusion food, and a rooftop that's equal parts lively and photogenic.
places.bestFor: Groups, nightlife, Indian fusion food, DJ nights

places.name: Asilah Jaipur
places.address: 4th Floor, Chandra Mahal Garden, Agra Road
places.verdict: Jaipur's most Instagrammable rooftop — Moroccan-Mediterranean design with white walls, terracotta accents, beautiful arches, and abundant greenery. The vibe is calm and romantic, a world away from the Hawa Mahal tourist cafes.

comparison.best for: Instagram photos, romantic dates, peaceful atmosphere, vegetarian dining
comparison.strengths: Stunning Moroccan decor · Mountain panoramas · Calm atmosphere · Vegetarian · Free Wi-Fi
comparison.limitations: Somewhat remote from Old City · Vegetarian only · Smaller crowd = less buzz
comparison.price / value: ₹800–₹1,400 for two · Fair for the aesthetic
comparison.what to order: The Mediterranean-inspired platters complement the setting. Cocktails, coffee, and desserts are the highlights. The Moroccan mint tea is on-theme and delicious.

places.whatToOrder: The Mediterranean-inspired platters complement the setting. Cocktails, coffee, and desserts are the highlights. The Moroccan mint tea is on-theme and delicious.
places.editorialSummary: Jaipur's most Instagrammable rooftop — Moroccan-Mediterranean design with white walls, terracotta accents, beautiful arches, and abundant greenery. The vibe is calm and romantic, a world away from the Hawa Mahal tourist cafes.
places.bestFor: Instagram photos, romantic dates, peaceful atmosphere, vegetarian dining

places.name: Daglaa The Terrace
places.address: 3rd Floor, Hotel Jaipur Heritage, Amer Rd
places.verdict: The highest-rated rooftop on this list at 4.6★ — a newer terrace with direct Amer Fort views that's still under the radar. Located on the Amer Road corridor, it catches the golden-hour light on the fort beautifully.

comparison.best for: Amer Fort views, quieter alternative, quality food
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ rating · Direct Amer Fort panorama · Less crowded · Banquet available
comparison.limitations: Smaller review count (newer) · Outside main city center · Limited public transport access
comparison.what to order: The Rajasthani thali is a safe bet. The terrace is the star — time your visit for sunset when Amer Fort glows amber.

places.verdict: A morning-to-night cafe on the Amer Road strip with Aravalli hill views, good coffee, and a relaxed atmosphere that works for both breakfast and evening drinks. Opens at 6 AM — rare for a rooftop.

comparison.best for: Early breakfast, coffee, laptop work, hill views
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · Opens 6 AM · Alcohol available · Great coffee · Pizza and Italian options
comparison.limitations: Far from Old City · Not directly facing a monument
comparison.what to order: The breakfast menu is the sleeper hit. Coffee and pizza are both solid. Try the loaded fries for a late-night snack.

places.name: TaBlu (Clarks Amer Hotel)
places.address: Hotel Clarks Amer, Jawahar Lal Nehru Marg
places.verdict: The luxury hotel rooftop bar option — on top of Clarks Amer with Nahargarh Fort views, live music, and premium cocktails. Think Dubai-level rooftop vibes transplanted to the Pink City.

comparison.best for: Premium cocktails, Nahargarh Fort views, special occasions
comparison.strengths: Nahargarh Fort view · Live music and karaoke · Premium spirits · Hotel bar service quality
comparison.limitations: Premium pricing · Evening-only (6–11 PM) · Smaller venue
comparison.what to order: Signature cocktails with the Fort as backdrop. The bar snacks are better than the full meals. Stick to drinks and light bites.

places.name: Nouba Restaurant & Rooftop Lounge
places.address: 3rd & 4th floor, C54-A, Sarojini Marg, C Scheme
places.verdict: A stylish two-level rooftop in the heart of C Scheme — Jaipur's most cosmopolitan neighborhood. The 4.5★ rating from 633 reviews speaks to consistent quality across food, drinks, and atmosphere.

comparison.best for: Central location, quality multi-cuisine, rooftop lounge vibe
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · C Scheme location · Full bar · Open until midnight
comparison.price / value: ₹1,200–₹2,000 for two · Good value for quality
comparison.what to order: The kebab platters and cocktail menu are both strong. The rooftop floor has the better atmosphere — ask for upstairs seating.

places.whatToOrder: The kebab platters and cocktail menu are both strong. The rooftop floor has the better atmosphere — ask for upstairs seating.
